title: 3.10 My, Your, His and Her
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Use mein, dein, sein and ihr with names and things; die-words add -e: seine Tasche.
speaking_outcome: Say whose name and thing it is.
